turns.question: Which of 1 or 2 October 2026 had more precipitation in Amsterdam, and how many orders were placed by customers in the Netherlands on that day?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no precipitation metric, so I cannot say which of the two days was wetter, and no metric in it is close enough to stand in for it. Orders from customers in the Netherlands (Orders, cancelled included, counted on the day placed): 3 on 1 October 2026 and 3 on 2 October 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
